query: What documentary standards and cross-checks will constitute sufficient evidence to claim revenues were or were not earmarked (e.g., matching concession ledgers to municipal budgets)?

response.query: What documentary standards and cross-checks will constitute sufficient evidence to claim revenues were or were not earmarked (e.g., matching concession ledgers to municipal budgets)?
response.answer: To claim revenues were earmarked, match concession ledgers to municipal budget allocations and track bank deposits against budget entries. Use signed agreements and official budget documents as primary evidence.
